thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P2 — elevated inference tail latency detected across inference-runtime pool (kv/batching/quantization signals). alert_id=IR-2026-0893. Affected models: llama-13b-quant, redwood/reranker-v2. Triggered at 2026-03-15T11:02:01Z. Pager routed to @priya (on-call). Link: <https://infra.internal/alerts/IR-2026-0893>

priya: taking it. looking at the rollout history and pool metrics now. can someone confirm if we had any quantization changes in the last deploy window? :eyes:

alex: I pushed a quantization artifact (mixed-8bit) for llama-13b at 10:45 UTC as an experiment. not the full rollout, just a canary to 10 nodes.

sam: seeing batcher queue depth spike on node-g-3 and node-g-7: `batcher.queue_depth ~= 1200` and `worker_stall=true` in logs. also repeated `KVCache: evict mismatch` errors in the same timeframe. adding logs below:
```
2026-03-15T11:01:58Z ERROR KVCache: applyDelta failed, evict_mismatch true, key=ctx:abcd1234
2026-03-15T11:02:00Z WARN batcher: queue_depth=1210 worker_stall=1 drain_time>200ms
2026-03-15T11:02:01Z ERROR inference: response_latency_ms=1420 model=llama-13b-quant
```

priya: that's consistent with a KV invalidation bug + batch backpressure. immediate plan: 1) stop canary quantized instances or revert quant artifact 2) temporarily disable dynamic batching on affected model route 3) perform rolling restart of the KV cache workers on the affected subset. thoughts?

li: +1 to stop canary. I can revert the canary build to stable (tag: llama-13b-stable) and redeploy the 10 nodes back to stable within ~5m. moving to rollback now.

carla: please update customers on impact if significant. which tenants are seeing errors? ops-bot, any customer impact summary?

ops-bot: Affected tenants with increased error rates: acme-corp, harbor-data, and 3 dev teams. Estimated error rate increase: 0.8% -> 4.6% for llama-13b-quant route between 11:01-11:05 UTC. No SSO or secrets exposure.

priya: thanks. alex, li — when you revert canary, also mark the canary instances out of rotation so we don't feed them traffic until we've validated. I'll flip batching config once rollback is in progress.

alex: ack. reverting canary now and setting canary_nodes=0. command I ran: `infractl deploy rollback --service=llama-13b --tag=llama-13b-stable --nodes=10 --reason="kv/batch latency"`

li: rollback done on canary nodes. health checks passing for those 10 nodes. marking them out of rotation until validation.

priya: flipping batching config for route `model=llama-13b-quant` to `batching.enabled=false` via runtime toggle (will only affect hosted routing). Doing now.

sam: I can kick rolling restart for KV cache worker pods on node-g-3 and node-g-7. command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/kv-cache -n inference --selector=node in (node-g-3,node-g-7)`

priya: do it. aim for staggered restarts, 1 pod at a time. watch for cache warmups.

sam: restarted. first pod back in ~45s, second pod back in ~50s. watching metrics.

incident-bot: Update: latency 95th dropped from 1.4s -> 220ms after rollback + batching disabled + kv restarts. Incident severity: degraded -> recovering.

carla: good. can we capture the timeline and create a postmortem? propose a 1-hour postmortem (blameless) scheduled within 24h. owners: priya (incident lead), alex (quant artifact), sam (runtime), li (deploy).

priya: assigning initial action items now:
- ACTION-1 (priya): prepare incident timeline and notes and create postmortem doc in #postmortems within 6h.
- ACTION-2 (alex): create revert/validation checklist for quantization canaries; include gating checks for KV and batching metrics. due EOD today.
- ACTION-3 (sam): add stronger backpressure detection and auto-drain before `worker_stall` hits 1000; spike detection rule. due in 3 days.
- ACTION-4 (li): ensure canary nodes are isolated and have circuit-breaker so they stop receiving traffic immediately on health anomalies. due in 5 days.
- ACTION-5 (carla): customer comms draft for affected tenants; send update within 2 hours.

alex: I'll also add a quick hotfix: modify quantization canary deploy to start with `batching.enabled=false` until KV cache warmup is measured. small PR coming.

priya: will set up postmortem meeting: proposed times 24h window: 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC or 2026-03-16 20:00 UTC. pinging relevant folks. :calendar: please react with preference.

li: prefer 15:00 UTC.

sam: 15:00 works for me.

carla: 15:00 fine.

incident-bot: NOTE: Please file postmortem doc at `<https://redwood/doc/postmortems/IR-2026-0893>` and include the fields: summary, timeline, impact, root cause hypothesis, mitigation, action items, owner, due_date.

priya: created draft postmortem: `<https://redwood/doc/postmortems/IR-2026-0893/draft>` — I'll fill timeline and initial root cause hypothesis (KV invalidation race triggered by quantization metadata change causing evict_mismatch; batching amplified slow responses and caused queue buildup).

sam: initial root cause looks right. follow-ups I'd like to track in the doc: 1) KVCache invariant check in applyDelta to fail fast and trigger fallback, 2) batcher should observe KV error rates and reduce batch sizes dynamically when errors spike, 3) end-to-end test that simulates kv evict mismatch + high concurrency.

alex: adding one more: quantization artifact packaging should include a compatibility checksum for KV metadata format. if mismatch, we should refuse to enable quantized mode.

priya: noted. I'm going to create a remediation tracking table in the doc. summarizing items + owners + due dates. will close loop in next on-call handoff.

oncall-rotation: FYI I'm next on-call starting in 12h. priya, please handoff the incident doc and any ongoing blocking items before shift change.

priya: will do. current blockers: no active blockers; all mitigations applied. primary remaining work is engineering follow-ups from action items. handing off the doc link and a quick brief in #eng-oncall before I sign off.

carla: thanks everyone. please mark your action items done in the postmortem doc when complete. we'll review progress in the postmortem meeting. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident IR-2026-0893 resolved -> status=recovered, duration=00:12:30, mitigation=rollback+batch_disable+kv_restart, severity=P2.

priya: closing here — I'll post meeting invite and update the postmortem doc. good catch team.

alex: thanks all.
